name: Anejoku
source:
The main character, Takafumi, has secret feelings for his older sister who is both intelligent and beautiful. Since his parents are working overseas, he lives with his older sister and gets along well with her.

One day, Takafumi witnesses his older sister Mayumi having fun with another man on her way home from school. Seeing her smile, which he had never seen before, Takafumi is attacked by intense jealousy. If this continues, his sister will belong to another man.

At that time, Takafumi consults an incestuous relationship community site that he found on the internet. So he decides to follow the advice he received and order the tools to make his sister his own. He must take action before her sister becomes another man's property. Takafumi's plan to reclaim his dear sister has begun.
translation:
新条贵文一直暗恋着聪明美丽的姐姐真由美。父母在海外工作，姐弟二人共同生活，感情一向亲密。

某天，贵文目睹放学回家的真由美与另一个男人相谈甚欢。姐姐脸上浮现出他从未见过的笑容，强烈的嫉妒顿时攫住了贵文。再这样下去，姐姐就会属于别的男人。

这时，贵文想起了自己在网上找到的近亲恋爱交流网站。他决定按照网友建议行事，还订购了各种能让姐姐属于自己的道具。必须赶在姐姐成为别人所有物前采取行动。夺回挚爱姐姐的计划就此开始。
